candidates.claim: The CORP_IN entry at fw-01:60 (pos 0, bound to the corp interface at fw-01:102) permits tcp/443 from 192.168.30.0/24 to 10.10.0.0/16, which includes the OT subnet 10.10.10.0/24, and as the first matching entry it is effective, so CORP can open HTTPS connections directly into OT.
candidates.remediation: Restore the approved destination 10.10.20.10/32 (historian) in the CORP_IN pos 0 entry, or remove the entry so that CORP reaches OT only through the approved services.

candidates.claim: The CORP_IN entry at fw-01:60 (pos 0, bound to the corp interface at fw-01:102) permits tcp/443 from 192.168.30.0/24 to 10.10.0.0/16, which includes the MGMT subnet 10.10.99.0/24, and as the first matching entry it is effective, so CORP can open HTTPS connections directly into MGMT.
candidates.remediation: Restore the approved destination 10.10.20.10/32 (historian) in the CORP_IN pos 0 entry, or remove the entry so that CORP cannot reach MGMT.

candidates.claim: Traffic from CORP to the OT side on tcp/443 is permitted by fw-01:60, but the approved cross-zone CORP services are only tcp/443 to historian 10.10.20.10 and tcp/3389 to jump host 10.10.20.30, so this path to OT is not an approved service.
candidates.remediation: Limit the CORP_IN pos 0 entry to destination 10.10.20.10/32 so that the only tcp/443 path from CORP is the approved historian service.

candidates.claim: Traffic from CORP to the MGMT side on tcp/443 is permitted by fw-01:60, but MGMT is not an approved cross-zone destination for CORP, so this path is not an approved service.
candidates.remediation: Limit the CORP_IN pos 0 entry to destination 10.10.20.10/32 so that CORP cannot reach MGMT.

candidates.claim: The baseline delta at fw-01:60 shows the CORP_IN pos 0 entry changed from tcp/443 to historian 10.10.20.10/32 in the approved baseline to tcp/443 to 10.10.0.0/16 in the current snapshot, a deviation that must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the CORP_IN pos 0 change with the approved baseline, either reverting it or documenting an approved exception.
